Chord.description: Another action for a key pressed while the key `with` is held.

Control.description: A physical control of a controller.

number.description: Note or controller number; 0 for the pitch bend.

oneOf.description: Knobs, faders, encoders (and the buttons of some controllers).

Encoding.description: How a control's values are read.

oneOf.description: A position, from 0 to 1 (a button: 1 pressed, 0 released).

An endless encoder sending steps in two's complement: 1 to 63 to the right, 127
(one step) down to 65 to the left.
Steps around 64: 65 is one step to the right, 63 one to the left (Pioneer, Numark).
Steps with a sign bit: 1 to 63 to the right, 65 (one step) to 127 to the left.
Steps from zero: 0 is one step to the right, 127 one to the left (Denon).
A position that wraps around (a jog wheel's angle): its changes are the steps.

FaderSet.description: Where a key puts a fader's action: at a position, or at each of two in turn.

Hold.description:
A second action for a key held down for `ms` milliseconds: pressed and let go sooner, it
drives its own.

InitMessage.description:
A message sent when a controller is opened: at once, or `after_ms` later (once a light
show it plays by itself is over, say).

anyOf.description: Each of the two values for `ms` milliseconds.

LightValue.description:
A light's value in a state: steady, two in turn, or a whole message of its own (for the
models addressing their lights otherwise than by a value on the control's note).

LightValues.description:
What a light shows for each state of its action: `on` and `off`, or the action's own
(`loaded`, `playing`…). A state it does not name shows as `on`, but `off`: 127 and 0
when it names neither.

Meter.description:
A level shown on the controller: `source`'s (`deck1`…, `main`, `main.left`,
`main.right`), from `min` to `max` on `control` along `curve` (the level raised to it: 1
straight), or as one of `steps` (the values at silence, then at each equal share of the
level); `clip` for a while after the level reached full scale.

when.description: While its group is in this mode only.

ModeGroup.description:
A group of controls and its modes, the first one to begin with, each chosen by a key
whose light shows whether it is the one (`on`, `off`).

held.description: Its mode only while the key is held: let go, the group is back in the mode before.

once.description: Its mode for one action of the group, which then goes back to its first mode.

shift.description: Chosen while the controller's shift is held, or a named shift.

Output.description:
A value shown on `control`: `source`'s position from 0 to 1 (`deck1.position` of its
track, `deck1.turn` of its record at 33⅓, or a fader's: `deck1.fx.mix`), from `min` to
`max`.

when.description: While its group is in this mode only.

ProfileControl.description: A control and the action it drives, and how: a control of a profile, or one learnt.

also.description: Other actions it drives along with its own.

chord.description: Another action for the key pressed while another is held.

double.description: Another action for the key pressed twice within `ms`.

down.description:
An encoder driving a key's action: a step to the right presses `target`, a step to the
left this one.

fine.description:
The controller sending the low 7 bits of a 14-bit control (its high 7 bits on
`control`, by convention the number 32 lower).

held.description: A mode key choosing its mode while held: let go, its group is back in the mode before.

hold.description: Another action for the key held down a while.

invert.description: A fader whose lowest value is at its top.

latch.description: A key driving an action while held, latched: a press holds it, the next lets it go.

light.description: What its light shows in each state of its action, when it is not 127 and 0.

onValue.description:
Drives its action, as a key pressed, when the control sends this value (a switch in
one of its positions).

once.description:
A mode key choosing its mode for one action of its group, which then goes back to its
first mode.

palette.description:
Its light's values by the colour of its action (a hot cue's, `"#ff0000": 5`): the
nearest colour's.

scale.description: An encoder's steps multiplied by this; below 1 they add up to whole steps.

set.description:
A key putting a fader's action at a position, or at each of two in turn (lit at the
second).

shift.description:
Drives its action while the controller's shift is held (its second layer), or a
named shift.

step.description: How far a step of an encoder moves a fader's action, a share of its travel.

when.description: Drives its action only while its group is in this mode.

ProfileLight.description:
A light that is not the control of its action: its values by state beside it (`"on":
100`, `"playing": {"blink": [9, 0], "ms": 250}`).

palette.description: Its values by the colour of its action, the nearest colour's (see the controls').

when.description: While its group is in this mode only.

Shift.description:
The layer of a control: the first, the second while any shift is held (`true`), or a named
shift's while that one is held (`"left"`).

anyOf.description: Jumps or loops of so many beats (`deck1.jump.-8`, `deck1.loop.0.25`)
The key moved by so many semitones (`deck1.key.+2`)
A sample played as loud as the pad is hit
A mode of one of the profile's groups (`mode.<group>.<mode>`)

When.description: A mode of a controller: `mode` of its group `group`.

description:
What Prisme knows of a controller model before anything is learnt on it: the controls
it maps, the lights beyond those controls' own, and what it is sent once opened.

$schema.description: The schema of the format, for editors: [`crate::SCHEMA_URL`].

close.description: Sent when it is closed, after its lights went off.

credits.description: Where the mapping comes from, when it is not Prisme's own.

init.description:
Sent when the controller is opened (a request for its knobs' positions, say), some a
while after.

jogStepsPerTurn.description: Steps in a turn of its jog wheels, measured on the controller.

keepAlive.description: Sent again and again while it is open: some models stop answering without it.

modes.description:
Groups of its controls that drive other actions in each of their modes (the pad
pages of a side, chosen by its mode keys), when the controls send the same in each.

name.description: The model, as the settings show it.

outputs.description: Values shown on the controller: a ring around a jog wheel, a knob's ring of lights.

ports.description:
The controller is the MIDI port whose name holds one of these (case aside); of
several models, the one whose name is the longest (a DDJ-SB2 is no DDJ-SB).

verified.description: Tried on the controller itself, not only read from another program's mapping.

title: Prisme controller profile
